query:
SELECT r.id AS "id: Uuid",
                  r.name,
                  u.user_name AS owner_name,
                  (r.user_id = $2 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1
                                             FROM repository_users ru
                                             WHERE ru.repository_id = r.id AND ru.user_id = $2)) AS "readable!: bool"
           FROM repositories r
                    JOIN users u ON u.id = r.user_id
           WHERE r.id = $1
